a.xlink:title: Base class for I_ (index based) and IIP_ (index based in-place) op codes.
IIP_ADD rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] += T.
IIP_AND rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] &= T.
IIP_DIV rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] *= T.
IIP_MOD rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] %= T.
IIP_MUL rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] *= T.
IIP_OR rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] |= T.
IIP_SHL rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] <<= T.
IIP_SHR rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] >>= T.
IIP_SHRALL rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] %= T.
IIP_SUB rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] -= T.
IIP_XOR rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] ^= T.
Base class for I_ (index based) and IIP_ (index based in-place) op codes.
An Op that operates on primitive types and can build optimized operations.
Base class for all XVM machine code instructions, each of which is called an "op".
An interface of default utility methods for implementing in-place operations.
A "mixin" interface to generate bytecodes for operations on Ecstasy 128-bit integer types.
A "mixin" interface to generate bytecodes for operations on Ecstasy numeric types.
A "mixin" interface to generate bytecodes for operations on Ecstasy Decimal types.
